description: Core outputs for automatic stamp progression, paired with the retained latest save
target: Gilded Stamp daily gain chance and No Stamp Left Behind daily stamp level count

extractions.label: gilded_stamp_gain_chance
extractions.description: Native probability from RiftStuff.1.25.js line 8. The public percentage result multiplies this by 100. Preserve values above 1 and the native Rift unlock gate.

extractions.label: no_stamp_left_behind_count
extractions.expression: (() => { const bundleCount = Number(idleon.getAttr("BundlesReceived").h.bun_s) === 1 ? 5 : 0; const eventCount = Number(idleon.callFunction("Summoning", "EventShopOwned", 1, 0)) === 1 ? 3 : 0; const summoningCount = Number(idleon.callFunction("Summoning", "WinBonus", 20, 0)); return bundleCount + eventCount + (summoningCount > 0 ? Math.round(summoningCount) : 0); })()
extractions.description: Read-only replay of the No Stamp Left Behind total from DailyResetTick.1.24.js line 8, also confirmed in native 1.25. One owned stamp receives this total in levels. The game adds 5 for bun_s, 3 for Stamp Stack, and the rounded positive Stamp LV/day winner bonus. This does not perform a daily reset or mutate stamp levels.
